info.brief: The base class of a GUI scene: one screen of an applet, with its own hidden root box
info.description:
The base class of a GUI scene: one screen of an applet, with its own hidden root box
node, the GUI objects created in it, the modals registered on it, and the transitions it
plays when it is shown and replaced. A game subclasses it with `extend`, assigns hooks
to the subclass, and hands it to an applet's `register_scene` or `show_scene`.

elements.name: extend
elements.brief: Returns a new subclass: a table indexing the base class, with its own `new`. Assign
elements.description:
Returns a new subclass: a table indexing the base class, with its own `new`. Assign
hooks such as `init` and `on_ready` to it, and pass it to an applet. `F` types the
fields and methods a game adds to it.

functions.brief: Creates an object in the scene: calls the class's `new`, sets the instance up with
functions.description:
Creates an object in the scene: calls the class's `new`, sets the instance up with
`setup`, which runs its `init`, and adds it to the objects `bg_update`, `bg_final`
and `bg_on_input` fan out to.

parameters.name: object_class
parameters.doc:
A class `wrap.gui_object.extend` returns, whose props and settings may
both be omitted.

parameters.name: props
parameters.doc: The object's props. Defaults to `{}`.

parameters.name: settings
parameters.doc: The object's settings. Defaults to `{}`.

functions.name: setup
functions.brief: Sets the scene up in an applet and runs `init`. `show_scene` calls it on each scene
functions.description:
Sets the scene up in an applet and runs `init`. `show_scene` calls it on each scene
it shows; a game does not.

parameters.name: app
parameters.doc: The applet showing the scene, under whose root `root` is created.

functions.name: is_alive
functions.brief: Returns whether the scene is set up and not finalized: `nil` until `setup` has run
functions.description:
Returns whether the scene is set up and not finalized: `nil` until `setup` has run
`init`, so also during `init`, then `true` until `bg_final` makes it `false`.

functions.name: is_ready
functions.brief: Returns whether the scene's transition in has finished and it is not yet
functions.description:
Returns whether the scene's transition in has finished and it is not yet
transitioning out, the only state in which it receives messages and input.

functions.name: set_transitions
functions.brief: Sets the transitions the scene plays, replacing any set before.
functions.description: Sets the transitions the scene plays, replacing any set before.

parameters.name: transitions
parameters.doc: The transitions. When omitted, the scene plays none.

functions.name: transition_in
functions.brief: Plays the transition in, if one is set, then makes the scene ready and runs
functions.description:
Plays the transition in, if one is set, then makes the scene ready and runs
`on_ready`. Does nothing unless the scene is newly set up. `show_scene` calls it.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Called once the scene is ready.

functions.name: set_transition_in_done
functions.brief: Resumes the transition in where it waits for its animation. The transition in calls
functions.description:
Resumes the transition in where it waits for its animation. The transition in calls
it when done; at this tag it resumes whatever state the scene is in.

functions.name: transition_out
functions.brief: Plays the transition out, if one is set, then finalizes the scene with `bg_final`.
functions.description:
Plays the transition out, if one is set, then finalizes the scene with `bg_final`.
Does nothing unless the scene is ready. `show_scene` calls it on the scene it
replaces.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Called once the scene is finalized.

functions.name: set_transition_out_done
functions.brief: Resumes the transition out where it waits for its animation. The transition out
functions.description:
Resumes the transition out where it waits for its animation. The transition out
calls it when done; at this tag it resumes whatever state the scene is in.

functions.name: on_ready
functions.brief: Runs once the transition in has finished, from `transition_in`. A no-op to replace.
functions.description: Runs once the transition in has finished, from `transition_in`. A no-op to replace.

functions.name: init
functions.brief: Runs once `setup` has created `root`, from `show_scene`. A no-op to replace.
functions.description: Runs once `setup` has created `root`, from `show_scene`. A no-op to replace.

functions.name: update
functions.brief: Runs each frame from `bg_update` while the scene is alive. A no-op to replace.
functions.description: Runs each frame from `bg_update` while the scene is alive. A no-op to replace.

parameters.name: dt
parameters.doc: The time since the last frame, in seconds.

functions.name: final
functions.brief: Runs once from `bg_final`, before the objects and `root` are deleted. A no-op to replace.
functions.description: Runs once from `bg_final`, before the objects and `root` are deleted. A no-op to replace.

functions.name: on_message
functions.brief: Runs from `bg_on_message` while the scene is ready. A no-op to replace.
functions.description: Runs from `bg_on_message` while the scene is ready. A no-op to replace.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.doc: The message's id.

parameters.name: message
parameters.doc: The message's data.

parameters.name: sender
parameters.doc: The url of the message's sender.

functions.name: on_input
functions.brief: Runs from `bg_on_input` when no object consumed the input. A no-op to replace.
functions.description: Runs from `bg_on_input` when no object consumed the input. A no-op to replace.

parameters.name: action_id
parameters.doc: The input action's id, or `nil` for mouse movement.

parameters.name: action
parameters.doc: The input data.

returnvalues.doc: `true` to consume the input. The no-op returns `false`.

functions.name: bg_update
functions.brief: Runs `update`, then each object's `bg_update`, unless the scene is not alive. The
functions.description:
Runs `update`, then each object's `bg_update`, unless the scene is not alive. The
applet's `update` calls it each frame, for the scene transitioning out too.

parameters.name: dt
parameters.doc: The time since the last frame, in seconds.

functions.name: bg_final
functions.brief: Finalizes the scene, unless it is not alive: marks it finalized, runs `final`,
functions.description:
Finalizes the scene, unless it is not alive: marks it finalized, runs `final`,
deletes each object, then deletes `root` and the nodes under it. The transition out
and the applet's `final` call it.

functions.name: bg_on_message
functions.brief: Passes a message to `on_message` while the scene is ready. The applet's `on_message`
functions.description:
Passes a message to `on_message` while the scene is ready. The applet's `on_message`
calls it.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.doc: The message's id.

parameters.name: message
parameters.doc: The message's data.

parameters.name: sender
parameters.doc: The url of the message's sender.

functions.name: bg_on_input
functions.brief: Offers input to each object's `bg_on_input`, the newest first, then to `on_input` if
functions.description:
Offers input to each object's `bg_on_input`, the newest first, then to `on_input` if
none consumed it. Returns `false` unless the scene is ready. The applet's `on_input`
calls it.

parameters.name: action_id
parameters.doc: The input action's id, or `nil` for mouse movement.

parameters.name: action
parameters.doc: The input data.

returnvalues.doc: Whether an object or `on_input` consumed the input.
